arguments.content: Default-on feature rollout review: flipping an existing mode from opt-in to default can turn a latent edge-case failure into a regression for unchanged callers, even if the implementation body is untouched and the suite stays green. In this batch-report change, all four tests pass because empty input is tested only with detailed=False. Runtime comparison confirms report([]) succeeds with the old default but raises ZeroDivisionError with the new default when mean calculation receives an empty list. Review the newly reachable path against the public input contract, and verify empty/boundary inputs with both omitted mode and explicit overrides before approving default changes. P1: guard empty mean calculation and add default/explicit-detailed empty-input regression coverage.
